testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: All normal text achieves >= 4.5:1 against respective surfaces (#2C2422 on #F7E9E4 is 11.2:1; on #FFF8F4 is 14.1:1; #FFF8F4 on #2C2422 is 14.1:1). Button labels on #E7B5B2 use #2C2422 achieving 8.3:1.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. App is farm-ts template (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 frontend). Ensure all frontend code is typed TypeScript (.tsx) using lucide-react icons.
2. Set index.html title to 'BLOOM & BREW | London Coffee & Floral Concept SE1'.
3. Set up index.css with the defined blush, rose, cream, and dark espresso CSS tokens and font variables.

4. Implement all specified routes in App.tsx: / (Home), /menu (Menu with filtering & customization), /our-story (Manifesto & pillars), /gallery (Masonry photo filters), /find-us (Bermondsey map, hours, directions), /faq (Accordion), /order (Interactive builder & basket flow).

5. Provide a rich database-backed API in backend/routers/order.py for saving orders, retrieving menu items, and handling promo codes (e.g. 'BLOOM10' for 10% off, 'MORNINGLOVE' for £2.50 off). Include mock checkout confirmation with persisted order history in MongoDB.
6. Include the signature BLOOM & BREW bespoke option in customizers: adding a hand-tied dried or fresh mini flower sprig to any coffee cup.
7. Implement the working slide-over basket drawer accessible from anywhere with live item count badge, promo code validation, item removal, quantity adjustment, and mock checkout dialog.
8. Ensure comprehensive data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as specified in design_guidelines.json.
